event_detail: Kettle: the gripper descends onto the kettle handle at 49.6 s, but at 51.2 s it has risen well above the counter and the kettle is still sitting on the counter, not in the gripper.
evidence: Wrist camera: at 46.4-48.0 s the kettle is at the right edge of the view; at 49.6 s the kettle handle arcs right across the fingers (grasp attempt); at 51.2 s the camera is high above the counter and the whole kettle is seen standing on the counter some distance below, with nothing between the fingers. Right shoulder view also shows the kettle still on the counter to the right of the stove at 51.2 s. Kettle not on stove, no burner lit.
